name: Apps
description: Apps capabilities. Includes Create an app from an app manifest., Export an app manifest from an existing app., Generate a temporary Socket Mode WebSocket URL that your app can connect to in order to receive events and interactive payloads over., Get a list of authorizations for the given event context.
